canonical_model: Unchanged Operation-only atomic apply and compensation Undo/Redo. Up remains synchronous semantic acceptance, not queued admission. Display, commit, Scene readiness, GPU completion and durability remain different facts.

owners.scene: Existing IncrementalRuntimeCoordinator/SceneCompiler/RuntimeScene; no scene in SDK or second projection owner
owners.canonical_work: Existing RuntimeCompositionCore captureCanonicalWork plus strict receivePlatformPresented; no new consumer token
owners.render: Existing SkiaRenderer, navigation/source/prepared/body/mask/pixel owners; same32/96MiB and frame allowances
owners.physical_completion: Existing SkiaSurfaceProvider and qualified GPU retirement; display records are not leases

preconditions: writable available same document/view/lifetime, permitted tool/source/pointer
latest committed Scene already ready or recoverable through existing Scene recovery independently of render
Stable valid metrics/binding; SDK metric flush/lifecycle work remains outside this stable-surface eraserBegin contract.
required: Recover Scene before hit-dependent use, including two Up events with no frame opportunity.
Create current gesture trace/session identity without canonical or preview acquire/raster/clear/present or forcing exact preparation.
Do not hide retained Brush/erase feedback merely because Down occurs.
Once source/admission rejects, existing terminal cleanup leaves no stranded contact/session.
valid_deferred_next_down.non_healthy_cases: Surface unavailable, stale/foreign identity, permission/reentrancy/real Scene recovery failure remain explicit existing admission failures; no stale query, fake commit, or blanket all-input acceptance.

prepare_before_apply: Current Scene/exact target result through current algorithm
EditorHistory.prepareRecord and all local fallible History storage
Bounded gesture/commit/display metadata and roster storage
transaction.failure_before_apply: Release reservation and cancel only uncommitted active gesture; no document, commit clock or History cursor mutation. No-op creates no Operation or History.
transaction.apply: Exactly one OperationEngine.apply using existing generation/ledger/clock; preserve complete record.
after_applied: Move/retain actual complete commit_record exactly once, including change_set and source/operation/commit identities.
Finalize already prepared History and volatile publication once; preserve original semantic acceptance even if derived Scene/render fails.
Keep equivalent canonical_commit observation, selection invalidation and observer/callback/reentrancy ordering. Avoid losing old observeApplied behavior by copying it incompletely.
Scene apply/recover uses accepted before/after generation/change_set and must not re-execute Operation.
Keep user-visible return accepted for committed Up; observer/derived failure cannot turn an applied commit into uncommitted/cancelled.
transaction.allocation_boundary: No new fallible mandatory History/display/publication storage after apply. Reuse prepared/move/noexcept support; not a global D07 or external observer-allocation guarantee.
transaction.undo_redo: Use existing History compensation engine. Independently prepare/recover current Scene before relevant Undo/Redo admission. Maintain current-state display proof after compensation; never reverse accepted Operation by deleting it.

display_records.capacity_policy: Bounded private metadata admission, reserved before apply; exhaustion rejects before canonical mutation. No silent eviction or performance watermarks. Test-only smaller capacity/fault injection may exercise the same admission helper without public API.
identity_fields: source/pointer generation,gesture/session identity and monotonic gesture serial
surface and metrics generations, provider/resource binding
camera/viewport and display source basis, object incarnation/mask identity where required
display_records.geometry_policy: Keep committed masks only in authoritative Scene. Active mask is disposable trace-derived feedback. Sealed records hold metadata, not another stroke/mask store; never reapply sealed masks on top of current canonical masks.

brush_display.preserve: Existing BrushEngine geometry, paint and preview style remain unchanged, including the established ARC style override where applicable. Original exact CanonicalVisible identity/path unchanged; no new ARC wire/API.
brush_display.transfer: Deferred Down alone never hides/clears valid retained ARC. Only an accepted, validated full-viewport current-Scene transient replacement containing its committed content may take its display ownership; suppress only those old represented contours from later shared-overlay render, retaining their logical commit/session identities.
brush_display.fresh_contours: New active or sealed C not frozen into that replacement remains visible and is never globally cleared/suppressed.
brush_display.completion: Original matching CanonicalVisible may retire through its existing strict path. A newer full exact frame may instead close an eligible older display demand via distinct ReplacedByCurrentFrame(B)/SupersededByCurrentState outcome, never by forging CanonicalVisible(A) or relabelling B as A. Retire/remove only identities proven by B frozen roster using existing Runtime/controller lifecycle methods; preserve required terminal controls.
brush_display.invalidation: Failed/stale/partial/translucent-unproven transient does not transfer ownership. Camera/Scene/surface/resource changes invalidate display proof and schedule current feedback; logical identities do not become successful receipts. Lifecycle display cancellation has a distinct reason and cannot revoke a semantic commit.

exact_replacement.freeze: From synchronized authoritative Scene at exact frame preparation, freeze bounded eligible records and complete basis; bind that immutable set only to successful actual renderer/coordinator/tracker submission and actual CanonicalWork from Core. Never enlarge at capture or completion.
exact_replacement.qualification: Existing Core work equality, tracker and RuntimeFrameCoordinator receive/retirePreview exact matching stay strict. A newer full current frame receives only its own qualified receipt.
outcomes: ReplacedByCurrentFrame(B): explicit full current projection covers eligible old demand
SupersededByCurrentState: Undo/Delete/current incarnation makes old effect no longer part of current state, proven from current Scene/commit basis
CancelledDisplayDemand: loss/hide/owner exit/new viewport cancels that display request, not a successful visible result
reject: Only revision/ordinal comparison without current projection/coverage proof
Approximate nav, partial tiles, unknown completion or provider submit alone
A record or active/sealed C created after frozen roster
exact_replacement.safety: Old A completion cannot clear B/C; cancelled A need not receive a fake A completion when exact B replaces its eligible display. GPU leases retire independently under UR1d.

current_scene_navigation.demand: Build separate disposable current FrameState/query from synchronized Scene and current camera/surface/resource identity. Keep captured old exact identities immutable; no original-frame restamping.
current_scene_navigation.composition_proof: Runtime supplies a private fully validated current-Scene composition FramePlan/proof independent of old pixels. Derive background, isolation/compositing, clip/metrics/resource/source scope using existing canonical defaults and FramePlan validation; no caller bool force-compatible bypass. Reuse immutable source data and avoid discarded canonical encoding/digest on policy/transient paths.
current_scene_navigation.regional_reuse: Renderer still requires target/resource identity, complete ordered source/body equality, object-specific historical/active masks and conservative AA/filter damage validity. Unknown/missing proof returns Pending/reject and preserves only genuinely valid feedback. No reuse of erased areas as current pixels.
current_scene_navigation.scheduling: Current camera feedback can present before exact canonical finishes; it is not CanonicalVisible or a canonical completion-slot user. Preserve useful same-basis jobs/progress, existing work allowance, current GPU decision and resource lifecycle. After input ends feasible current exact work must finish fairly; no always-transient scheduler that starves exact.
current_scene_navigation.backpressure: Temporary actual target/metadata shortage returns bounded retry with demand/progress, no whole-frame synchronous CPU fallback or repeated from-zero work. Genuine lost/invalid targets keep UR1d classification.

required_orders: A/B committed, A rendering cancelled, only exact B completion
Scene apply failure -> next erasure -> recovery success/failure
A-Up -> wheel pan / ctrl-wheel zoom while canonical pending
Brush seal -> partial erase with real visible overlay and later qualified replacement
semantic_conflict_policy: No upstream schema or consumer-semantic reinterpretation authorized. If existing owner contracts cannot express these private display distinctions, report exact conflict before expanding API/semantic scope.
